name: gust-pr
description: If you're going to use Claude, ChatGPT or your preferred AI companion as your PR team, at least make sure they know PR's best practice, instead of mediocre advice resulting in press releases and pitches no journalist will reply to. Open craft from Gust PR: an Editor in Chief who says no, a Chief Trend Officer who runs your Monday, and the skills they work from. Built in Australia.
